never mind phrase

also let it be, let it go, forget it, drop it, it doesn’t matter, drop it, please!, let’s drop the subject, no more of that!, never mind what he says

classical

Traupman 104
Traupman 33

Sine!

never mind! let it be

Other words

  • Mitte! — never mind, drop it

    imperative of mittō, with or without an object (mitte istaec) · also used · classical · Ter. Ad. 838–839; Ter. And. 762–764: Mitte id quod sciō; Traupman 104: never mind what he says, mitte id quod dīcit; Traupman 307

    (vōx sermōnis cotīdiānī: Plaut., Ter.)

  • Āctum nē agās. — don’t do over what’s done (let it go)

    also used · classical · Ter. Ph. 419

    (prōverbium: Ter.)

  • missa facere — drop, let go (a subject)

    also used · classical · Cic. Rosc. Am. 132: missa faciam (Lewis & Short s.v. mittō); Traupman 97; Traupman 307

    “To treat as let go”: the neuter plural of missus with facere.

Examples

  • Tacē: nōn fīet: mitte jam istaec: dā tē hodiē mihi: exporge frontem.

    Hush, it won’t happen; drop all that; give me today; smooth your brow.Ter. Ad. 838–839

  • Āctum, ajunt, nē agās.

    Don’t redo what’s done, as they say.Ter. Ph. 419

  • Missa istaec fac!

    Drop it! No more of that!Traupman 97

  • Mitte, amābō!

    Drop it, please!Traupman 97

  • Missa haec faciāmus.

    Let’s drop the subject.Traupman 97

See also it makes no difference, leave me alone!, don’t worry!.
